prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: config-diff
description: Compares two flat configuration maps and returns a structured diff.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /diff
  description: 'body {old: {string:string}, new: {string:string}}. 200 {added:{k:v},
    removed:{k:v}, changed:{k:{old:v, new:v}}}; 400 if old or new is missing or not
    an object'
metrics:
- name: config_diffs_total
  type: counter
  help: Diff requests served
- name: config_diff_changes_last
  type: gauge
  help: Number of differing keys in the most recent diff
behaviors:
- Identical configs produce empty added, removed and changed objects (not null)
- config_diff_changes_last equals added+removed+changed of the latest successful diff
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /diff
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"old": {"a": "1", "b": "2"}, "new": {"a": "1", "c": "3"}}'
- method: POST
  path: /diff
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"old": {"a": "1"}}'
- method: POST
  path: /diff
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"old": "x", "new": {}}'
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- configDiffsTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `config_diffs_total`; use Inc/Add
- configDiffChangesLast  (gauge) -> exposed as `config_diff_changes_last`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /diff  body {old: {string:string}, new: {string:string}}. 200 {added:{k:v}, removed:{k:v}, changed:{k:{old:v, new:v}}}; 400 if old or new is missing or not an object
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
